scope: Bounded thermal/energy/positivity/jet-screen diagnostics; no production release.

initialization.note: Odd-in-y projection of original streamfunction, same phases and |n|²=5; walls v=0 and tangential stress free. Jet balanced with f(y) and tilted rotation using a thermodynamic adjustment; eddy balance uses f0 with finite small beta adjustment. Widened y preserves the original physical eddy wavelengths. Finite-amplitude mixed-sign flow; mass and kinetic energy matched; pressure/density and balanced thermal/potential energy differ for rotation-dependent balance. No mature thermal parent.
